title: Microsoft Purview: export DLP and label policy configurations as a ZIP file (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the export behaviour, portal paths and government-cloud release details are supported. The missing-path-word pre-checks are resolved by other cited Microsoft pages; the briefing correctly separates diagnostic PowerShell exports from the portal feature and reports the conflicting labeling licence guidance.
